title: Phone on sleep and lock screen causing connection issues - huawei
symptom: While the phone's display is on sleep mode or screen lock, the capture rate is approximately 20%. When the screen is switched back on, xdrip status screen shows scanning commenced at the same time. Using a Keep Screen On app overnight increased capture rate to >90%.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. Possible causes mentioned include aggressive task scheduler in the Android build, battery optimization, and Bluetooth issues, but none are confirmed.
fix: The thread does not state a definitive fix. Workarounds mentioned include keeping the screen on, setting xDrip to ignore battery optimization, and trying older wakelocks, but these are not confirmed resolutions.
evidence_quote: I have 'Run collector in Foreground' checked in xdrip settings too. So could this be a Huawei oreo issue? Or coding within Xdrip?
